Name: Multiplayer Independent Farms
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Note: This is a multiplayer mod. Both the host and clients must install it for it to work properly[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]注：这是一个联机模组。主机和客机都必须安装才能正常运行[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Please note: This version is not compatible with Android. Do not attempt to run it on Android devices[/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]请注意，此版本不适合安卓端，请不要尝试在安卓端上运行[/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b]Independent Farm Types:[/b] All multiplayer clients can now choose their own farm type, completely independent of the host.[/*]
[*][b]Unique Farm Names:[/b] Farm names must be unique. Clients are required to choose a name different from the host's farm.[/*]
[*][b]Independent Buildings:[/b] Greenhouses are now independent for each player, but the bat cave remains shared.[/*]
[/list]这个模组让联机的所有玩家都能够选择自己的农场类型，
并独立于主机农场之外。
请注意，农场名不可重复，
客机的玩家需要更改区别于主机农场名字的农场名称。
其次，温室是独立的，但是蝙蝠洞是共享的

Mods.DisplayName: Multiplayer Independent Farms（联机独立农场）

Manifest.Name: Multiplayer Independent Farms（联机独立农场）
Manifest.Description: 让联机玩家各自拥有独立的可选类型农场，可通过地图上方通道自由前往其他玩家的农场。
Manifest.Author: MoYu
